protocol: Patient-disjoint held-out cases from data/splits/test.json (configs/heldout_cases.json), first N sorted by id. Ground truth: BraTS 2023 GLI expert labels (ET=3). Same pipeline as the API. Threshold 0.5, not tuned.
caveat: Development-set results on BraTS 2023 GLI data. NOT hidden-case performance. The organiser baseline is not available locally, so no baseline comparison is made.
